summary_markdown:
The session covered multiple data updates and troubleshooting for two companies (7600 and 7912).

**Initial Updates:** Calibration was performed for Company 7600 at Mall 78 and Rail 78, updating both production and staging environments. Later, calibration was also requested/performed for Company 7912 at facility 78 (production and staging).

**Troubleshooting Aggregation:** Issues were discussed regarding session data aggregation for Company 7912, particularly concerning missing unique user IDs and dwell time after a recent change. It was determined that the first attempt to run the aggregation script might have failed due to data distribution synchronization issues across shards, while subsequent runs succeeded.

**Future Requirements:** The team agreed on several follow-up tasks for Company 7912:
*   Recalculate historical session data (including dwell time) starting from March 1, 2024, for both production and staging environments.
*   Create a campaign fix/adjustment for Company 7912 and Company 7600 (AFA) in the production environment.
decisions: Calibration updates were completed for Company 7600 (Mall 78, Rail 78) and Company 7912 (facility 78).
Historical session data recalculation (including dwell time) for Company 7912 must be performed for both production and staging environments starting March 1, 2024.
A campaign fix/adjustment needs to be implemented for Company 7912 and Company 7600 in the production environment.
action_items: Recalculate historical session data (including dwell time) for Company 7912 (Prod & Stage, from 2024-03-01).
Implement campaign fix/adjustment for Company 7912 and Company 7600 in production.
